Name: Many Mouths to Feed
Description: This gargantuan, multi-mawed monstrosity has long feasted on local wildlife, using potent toxins to neutralize its prey. Left unchecked, its impact on the isle's already-beleaguered ecosystem will be dire.

Name: Doubled Trouble
Description: This formidable familiar is wrought in the likeness of an ancient Mhachi sorceress. Rid the North Horn of this duplicate and their corrupting aether.

Name: Quarried Away
Description: First given life during the War of the Magi, this towering stone golem now stalks the warped landscape of the North Horn. Reduce this alabaster renegade to rubble.

Name: Forbidden Folios
Description: With a giant sealed grimoire for a head, this well-read familiar lurks among dusty shelves and timeworn tomes. Unfortunately for the creature, the arcane techniques inscribed upon its pages pose too great a danger to ignore.

Name: Cursed Resurgence
Description: Once subjected to a sorcerer's cruel experiments, this dragon is now risen again, cursing all who approach. Only in death will this blighted creature know peace.

Name: Imbalanced Diet
Description: Born of an ancient curse, this rampaging beast thinks of naught but satiating its voracious appetite for vegetables. Intervene before nary an allium remains on the isle.

Name: Web of Terror
Description: This vicious voidsent stalks the unhallowed hamlet with a swarm of hungry underlings in tow. Cease their scuttling before the isle is overwhelmed.

Name: A Beast Unleashed
Description: Having grown so powerful as to thwart the grasp of its master, this hulking brute now wanders the North Horn in search of prey. Will you be the one to end its reign of terror?

Name: Dark Artistry
Description: Responsible for the deaths of countless innocents during the War of the Magi, the threat of this foul necromancer looms large once again. Purge the isle of its malign presence.

Name: Familiar Tactics
Description: Imbued by its creator with a warrior's indefatigable spirit, this familiar has waged a long and deadly war. While that spirit endures, no corner of the isle will be safe.

Name: Appalling Behavior
Description: Head filled with the memories of an ancient summoner, this blue-hued construct is an affront to the isle. Ensure its accursed powers are silenced once and for all.

Name: Tiny Terror
Description: This miniaturized mammet was crafted during the last days of the War of the Magi, and is very much equipped for battle. Do not let its adorable form stay your hand.

Name: Lost on the Wind
Description: This winged beast scours the isle for interlopers, kidnapping them to fuel its nefarious deeds. Will you vanquish this wretched jailor, or find yourself behind bars?

Name: Ahead of the Competition
Description: Roused from eternal slumber by sorcerous powers, this many-necked menace has left a trail of destruction in its wake. May cooler heads prevail.

Name: Accept No Imitators
Description: Well versed in the art of mimicry, this devious creature is wreaking havoc on the isle. Deal with them swiftly, lest you too fall victim to their tricks.

Name: The Forked Tower: Magic
Description: A shimmering spire presides over the warped landscape of the North Horn. Has the time come for your long-awaited encounter with the isle's architect?

Name: The Forked Tower: Magic (Extreme)
Description: A shimmering spire presides over the warped landscape of the North Horn. Has the time come for your long-awaited encounter with the isle's architect?
